text:
jamal: Heads-up — starting cutover prep for nova-13b-quantv3 in eu-west. Change window T+30m. Proposed pin order: nova-13b:quantv3 (primary), nova-13b:quantv2 (hot-fallback), nova-13b:quant-lite (cold-fallback). Ops, please ACK and list readiness blockers.

ellen: ACK. I'll spin up extra warm pools and watch cold fallback latency. telemetry + smoke evals on my side.

karim: Rollout owner here. Rollout plan: canary 4% for 12m -> 25% for 20m -> 100% by +2h with linear ramp. Rollback conditions: p95_token_latency >= 320ms for 6m OR total 5xx > 1% over 10m OR perceptual quality drop >2pts on our rouge-like eval. Canary must hit KV hit-rate >= 90%.

deploybot: Canary scheduled. run=cb-7785 model=nova-13b-quantv3 region=eu-west start=2610043250 traffic=4% duration=12m. I will auto-drain and pin to quantv2 on trigger unless a manual override is issued.

infra-bot: Dashboard: https://obs.internal/dash/nova-13b-quantv3-eu. Alerts: p95_token_latency>=320ms(6m), 5xx_total>1%(10m), eval_quality_drop>2pts. Retention snapshot created.

ellen: Quick Q — does quant-lite maintain identical KV-key hashing? We need cache compatibility to avoid cold starts.

karim: Yes — quant-lite uses the same KV key scheme; we rehydrate on load. Expect ~20% slower long-prefix completion but fine for cold fallback.

jamal: Release note draft for #product (will paste after successful 25%):

``
- Enabled nova-13b-quantv3 in eu-west with fallback chain [quantv3, quantv2, quant-lite].
- Expected median latency decrease ~10-15% based on perf runs.
- Rollback: p95>=320ms(6m) || 5xx>1%(10m) || quality_drop>2pts.
- Telemetry: https://obs.internal/dash/nova-13b-quantv3-eu
```

ellen: I'll post +1m and +10m smoke results here. Karim will own the final pin to 100%.

karim: Noted. If all green, I'll initiate the 25% step at T+12m. If anything trips, manual rollback command: `/deploybot rollback catalog nova-13b pin=quantv2 reason="telemetry"`.

deploybot: Affirmative — will post status and incident thread if I drain. Good luck :rocket:
